g.text: Tacit knowledge becomes a structured substrate that agents can query selectively, governed so it stays honest.
Fragmented · hard to query · decays over time · invisible to an agent until explicitly provided
structured, queryable, cross-linked nodes that capture the relevant knowledge in a form the agent can read
A machine-readable substrate that captures the knowledge the agents need to do reliable work.
The speciﬁc shape of the graph differs by use case. The methodology stays the same.
keep the graph current as the
Code, documentation, migrated systems, and decisions produced under structural constraint and validated against the graph.
Auditable. Traceable. Governed. The knowledge graph grows with every cycle and remains an asset of the enterprise.
